text:
Because emptiness is empty.
A bodhisattva is not apprehended in the future.
Because the emptiness of the essential nature of non-entities is empty.
A bodhisattva is not apprehended in the future.
Because the emptiness of the essential nature of non-entities is isolated.
A bodhisattva is not apprehended in the future.
Because the emptiness of the essential nature of non-entities does not exist.
Because the emptiness of the essential nature of non-entities is essenceless.
A bodhisattva is not apprehended in the future.
Because the emptiness of the essential nature of non-entities does not exist.
The bodhisattva is not apprehended in the middle.
Because the emptiness of the essential nature of non-entities is empty,
the bodhisattva is not apprehended in the middle.
Because the emptiness of the essential nature of non-entities is isolated,
the bodhisattva is not apprehended in the middle.
The emptiness of the essential nature of non-entities is not the bodhisattva, and the middle is not apprehended.
And why?
Venerable Śāradvatīputra,
because the emptiness of the essential nature of non-entities is non-existent,
and the emptiness of the emptiness of the essential nature of non-entities is empty,
The emptiness of the essential nature of non-things is isolated.
The emptiness of the essential nature of non-things has no prior limit.
